Put $q_*(x)=\frac12\sin(\pi x)$ and $u_*(x)=q_*(x)/(\pi^2+1)$, which solve the state equation. Set $p_*(x)=-q_*(x)$ and $u_d(x)=u_*(x)+\frac12(\pi^2+1)\sin(\pi x)$. Define $J(q)=\frac12\|u(q)-u_d\|_{L^2}^2+\frac12\|q\|_{L^2}^2$. Then $q_*$ is the unique optimal control, and its adjoint is $p_*$.
